title: Breathwork vs Sleep Quality Lift
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breathwork:session
| search next_sleep_score_delta=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(next_sleep_score_delta) as avg_next_sleep_score_delta by _time session_done
| sort - _time
description: Tracks sleep lift after breathwork days over time and breaks it out by breathwork flag.
value: Sleep lift after breathwork helps you decide whether the routine belongs in the evening, not just the app.
implementation: Send sleep lift after breathwork days events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of sleep lift after breathwork days by breathwork flag.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how sleep lift after breathwork days changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
